ValueWhat it configuresKeys
imageThe Cryo image for the API, workers, governor, scheduler, scanner and CronJobs.repository, tag, digest, pullPolicy
imagePullSecretsPull secrets added to every pod.—
serviceAccountThe ServiceAccount Cryo's pods run as. Annotate it for IRSA.create, name, annotations
podSecurityContextPod security context applied to every Cryo pod.runAsNonRoot, runAsUser, runAsGroup, fsGroup, seccompProfile

workerThe maintenance worker Deployment.replicas, resources
governorThe admission governor Deployment (leader-elected).replicas, probe, resources
schedulerThe cron scheduler Deployment (leader-elected).replicas, resources
